name: Instapage
label: Instapage — form-submit webhook ingress
description: Instapage inbound form-submit webhook ingress. Single :listen operation (trigger.listen); no Instapage REST write surface on this node. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Never log form PII.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Blocked on the canvas when trigger.listen (:listen role) is active; inbound Instapage webhooks route via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and emit normalized event data on output.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Inbound Instapage webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Operation to run. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Node-scoped API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node via full URL key (.../runtime/message-events/<apiKey>) or X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header (verified alongside the provider's secret header).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Bearer Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header Authorization. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: Authorization).
